answer: PoA binds each agent identity to a remotely attested enclave measurement: MRENCLAVE for Intel SGX, or the corresponding launch measurement for AMD SEV, covering approved code and configuration. Peers verify this evidence before accepting votes, so copying credentials or spawning virtual machines cannot produce another valid identity. Creating Sybil identities therefore requires new physical silicon and fresh attested instances, not duplication of a timber, garden, or opal software image.
